title: Module scan
noModules: No control modules are declared for this vehicle profile. Module scan needs a profile with a module list (see the Golf Plus example) — the generic profile scans the engine only, via the Fault codes screen.
discoverBelow: Discover modules below finds the modules this car answers on.
needsCan: Module scan needs a CAN (UDS) link. On K-line cars a generic ELM327 reaches the engine ECU only — use the Fault codes screen for engine faults.
help: Scans every declared module for identification (part number, software) and fault codes with VAG code numbers — like a VCDS auto-scan, over the modules this adapter can reach.

tp20.title: Pre-UDS modules (TP2.0)
tp20.help: ⚠ Experimental. Older VAG modules (cluster, comfort, gateway) speak VW TP2.0, not UDS. This opens a channel to the gateway, reads its installation list, and identifies each module. On a real generic ELM327 this is timing-sensitive and may not work on every adapter.
tp20.monitorUnavailable: The TP2.0 scan reads the bus in raw-CAN monitor mode, which a Classic Bluetooth adapter link cannot stream. Use a Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi adapter for pre-UDS modules.
tp20.noTraffic: No raw-CAN traffic seen — this adapter may not support TP2.0 (many clones), or the bus is asleep. Check ignition and try again.

reason.tp20: This module speaks VW TP2.0 (pre-UDS) — use the "Gateway scan (TP2.0)" action on this screen to read it. See docs/features/module-scan.md.
reason.silent: No response on this address — module absent, asleep, or a different address on this car.
reason.notClearable: Not clearable over this transport yet.

discover.title: Discover modules
discover.help: Asks each known VW-group module address for its part number (read-only) to find which control modules really answer on this car. Takes a few seconds per silent address.
discover.shared: Addresses {{list}} share these CAN ids on some cars, so one module answered for both. Shown as {{address}}; switch if its ident says otherwise.
discover.sharedIdent: Addresses {{list}} share these CAN ids on some cars, so one module answered for both. Shown as {{address}} from its ident ({{system}}); switch if its ident says otherwise.
discover.listed: Already in this car's module list.
discover.add: Add to this car's module list
discover.builtIn: This car is a built-in profile, which lives in the app's code. Paste this entry into its modules list (developer step), or add the car to My garage to keep the module on this phone.
discover.silent: No answer: {{list}}. Silence is not proof a module is missing — older modules may use VW TP2.0 instead.

history.title: Saved scans ({{count}})
history.searchPlaceholder: VAG number, P-code or text (e.g. 08579, P2183, coolant)
history.noMatch: No fault in the last scan matches “{{query}}”.

compare.title: Compare scans
compare.noEarlier: No earlier scan of this car — pick a baseline above.
compare.pickTwo: Pick two different scans to compare.
compare.none: No differences between these two scans.
